name: Needham Park and Recreation Summer Camps
description_short: Town of Needham Park and Recreation runs several summer day camps: Art Lab, Jr. All Stars, Kids off Broadway, KidzArt, Summer Recess (Explorers, Adventurers and Summer Bridges), Sports Specialties and Tennis Academy. Camps run in weekly sessions from late June to mid-August, with drop-off from 9:00am. Campers bring their own lunch and two nut-free snacks.
